title: Studio cannot report or chart on the package's own objects: the report and dashboard-widget dataset pickers list only pre-existing sys_/showcase_ datasets, and Studio offers no way to create a dataset
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Found in the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX), at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, Console built in-repo from the same commit.

## Repro (fresh boot)

1. Boot `examples/app-showcase` with `--seed-admin` and sign in as admin. Viewport 1440×900.
2. From Home choose **New in Studio**, create a package (e.g. "Field Service"), and create an object **Work Order** with an optional Number field **Estimated Hours** and a Picklist **Status** (option value `new`, label `New Request`). Create a second object, **Site**.
3. Open **Interfaces → +** and choose **Report**. Open the **Dataset** picker.
4. Create a dashboard, choose **Add widget → Bar chart**, and open its **Dataset** picker.

## Expected

An admin building a first app can report on and chart that app's objects from Studio: either a dataset exists or can be offered for each object, or there is a visible "New dataset" path.

## Actual

Both pickers list only `sys_*` and `showcase_*` metric datasets, none for Work Order. Studio has no "new dataset" action anywhere. The empty-state string "There is no dataset to report on yet … create a dataset first" (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts`) appears only when zero datasets exist, so on any stack with platform datasets it never shows. Even when it does show, it does not say where to create one. The walkthrough's dashboard was left with no widgets.
